tool_args.rationale: The pilots cover only H<=0.48, while the target horizon is 22.8 and the verified mechanism predicts slow adaptation and possible reversal. A slow-horizon measurement is needed before fitting.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter sink-coupled dual-horizon model immediately
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five short-horizon rows cannot reliably identify the slow adaptation needed for forecasts near H=22.8.
The slow-horizon probe directly resolves the forecast-horizon ambiguity at comparable cost.
It does not address the temporal identifiability problem.
